hypervelocity_check.note: The same model at 6 km/s gives beta = 1.96-8.27, consistent with the beta ~ 2-3 reported for hypervelocity impacts and with the DART result (beta ~ 3.6 at 6.1 km/s on a rubble-pile asteroid, an upper bound not applicable to a solid metal target). The model therefore reproduces the regime the literature's numbers come from, which is why its much lower value at 619 m/s should be believed rather than the literature value being extrapolated down.
